name: showcase
description: Animated stories for social posts, built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts DayOne-Vertical out/day-one-vertical.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts DayOne-Landscape out/day-one-landscape.mp4
scripts.render:spaghetti: for c in Faith Nebula Void Horizon; do for f in Vertical Landscape; do remotion render src/index.ts $c-$f out/spaghetti-$c-$f.mp4 --gl=swangle --concurrency=4 || exit 1; done; done
